A.name: Azariah
A.line: son of Johanan, who executed the priest's office in the temple that Solomon built (1CH 6:10)
A.notes: 1 Kings 4:2 names Azariah the son of Zadok the priest first among Solomon's princes; whether he is this priest or Azariah the son of Ahimaaz, Zadok's grandson (1CH 6:9), the text does not say. The Azariah who withstood King Uzziah in the temple (2CH 26:17-20) is held as azariah-20.

B.name: Azariah
B.line: Priest, son of Meraioth, father of Amariah, in Ezra's genealogy.
family: son-of meraioth (Meraioth, father of Amariah (1CH 6:7), Levite (1CH 6:1))

kjv.EZR 7:3: The son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,

disputed_verses.KJV EZR 7:3: The son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,

first_reader_said: EZR 7:3: Both records hold the Azariah who is father of Amariah-2 and descendant of Meraioth in this shortened high-priestly line.

why: Ezra 7:3 gives Azariah as the ancestor of Amariah in an abbreviated priestly genealogy, matching the Azariah who is Johanan's son and Amariah's father in 1 Chronicles 6:10–11. Meraioth is an earlier ancestor in that line, so Ezra's wording does not establish a different immediate father. B duplicates this occurrence; A's direct father links to Meraioth and Zadok need qualification, and its identification with the Azariah of 1 Kings 4:2 remains uncertain.
